This is a digital graveyard management a: This is a digital graveyard management and funeral services system. It allows users to search for grave information, register services, donate, request tahlil, and access various Islamic features in one platform.
Yes, basic usage is free. Some services: Yes, basic usage is free. Some services such as tahlil requests, service quotations, and donations may involve charges depending on the package selected.
You can log in using your Google account: You can log in using your Google account via the 'Sign in with Google' button on the Settings page. Logging in allows you to save transaction records and access additional features.
What data does this application store?: What data does this application store?
The app only stores information you prov: The app only stores information you provide when making requests or transactions, such as name, email, phone number, and payment details. This data is used solely to process your requests.
How do I search for grave information?: How do I search for grave information?
Go to 'Search Grave' from the main menu. You can search by the deceased's name, grave number, or location. Results will show detailed information about the deceased and grave location.
How do I use the QR scanner?: How do I use the QR scanner?
Select 'Scan QR' from the main menu and: Select 'Scan QR' from the main menu and point your camera at the QR code on the gravestone or information board. The app will immediately display complete information about the deceased.
Grave information was not found. What sh: Grave information was not found. What should I do?
The information may not yet be registere: The information may not yet be registered in the system. Please contact the graveyard management or the relevant organisation to register the grave information.
Can I view the grave location on a map?: Can I view the grave location on a map?
Yes, if the grave's GPS location has bee: Yes, if the grave's GPS location has been recorded, you can view it on a map. Make sure location permission is enabled on your device for this feature.
How do I make a donation?: How do I make a donation?
Go to 'Donation' from the main menu. Sel: Go to 'Donation' from the main menu. Select the recipient (organisation or tahfiz centre), enter the donation amount, fill in your details, and choose a payment method. Google sign-in is required to record the transaction.
We accept payments via credit/debit card: We accept payments via credit/debit card, FPX (online banking), and other online payment platforms supported by our system.
How do I check my donation status?: How do I check my donation status?
Sign in with Google and go to Settings >: Sign in with Google and go to Settings > Transaction Records to view all donations made. The status will be shown as Pending, Verified, or Rejected.
Can I donate to a tahfiz centre?: Can I donate to a tahfiz centre?
Yes. When making a donation, select 'Tah: Yes. When making a donation, select 'Tahfiz Centre' as the recipient type, then choose your desired centre from the list.
The Tahlil service allows you to request: The Tahlil service allows you to request a tahlil recitation for the deceased at a nearby tahfiz centre. You can select services, list the deceased's names, and make payment online.
How do I submit a tahlil request?: How do I submit a tahlil request?
Select 'Tahlil' from the main menu. Choo: Select 'Tahlil' from the main menu. Choose a tahfiz centre, enter the deceased names, select services, and complete payment. You will receive a reference number once the request is successful.
How do I check my tahlil request status?: How do I check my tahlil request status?
Go to 'Check Tahlil Status' and enter yo: Go to 'Check Tahlil Status' and enter your reference number received at the time of the request. The status will show whether it is Pending, Accepted, Completed, or Rejected.
Can I watch the tahlil live?: Can I watch the tahlil live?
Yes, if the tahfiz centre activates a li: Yes, if the tahfiz centre activates a live session, a video link will be shown in your request status. Press 'Join Live' to watch.
I lost my reference number. How do I ret: I lost my reference number. How do I retrieve it?
Sign in with Google and go to Settings >: Sign in with Google and go to Settings > Transaction Records. All tahlil requests you have made will be listed along with their reference numbers.
A Quotation allows you to request a pric: A Quotation allows you to request a price quote for burial or grave maintenance services from a registered organisation. You can select required services and make payment online.
How do I submit a quotation request?: How do I submit a quotation request?
Go to the relevant organisation or grave: Go to the relevant organisation or graveyard page and select 'Request Service'. Fill in your details, select the required services, and complete payment.
How do I check my service status?: How do I check my service status?
Go to 'Check Service Status' and enter y: Go to 'Check Service Status' and enter your reference number. The status will show whether the service is Pending, Completed, or Rejected.
What does the 5% platform fee mean?: What does the 5% platform fee mean?
The 5% platform fee is a service charge: The 5% platform fee is a service charge applied to the total payment amount. 95% of the payment will be received by the service-providing organisation.
Can I view the completion photo of the s: Can I view the completion photo of the service?
Yes. Once the organisation uploads a com: Yes. Once the organisation uploads a completion confirmation photo, it will be displayed in your quotation request status.
What is the Death Charity scheme?: What is the Death Charity scheme?
The Death Charity scheme is a mutual sav: The Death Charity scheme is a mutual savings scheme where members pay monthly or yearly contributions. When a member or their dependent passes away, the family receives a benefit payout from the scheme's fund pool.
How do I register as a member?: How do I register as a member?
Please contact the organisation managing: Please contact the organisation managing the nearest Death Charity scheme for registration. Organisation information can be found through the search feature in the app.
How do I make a contribution payment?: How do I make a contribution payment?
Members can make payments through the de: Members can make payments through the dedicated Death Charity page for their scheme. Enter the member's IC number, select the payment plan (registration with yearly fee, or yearly only), and complete the payment.
How do I submit a claim?: How do I submit a claim?
Contact the scheme manager or organisati: Contact the scheme manager or organisation administrator to start the claim process. Required documents typically include a death certificate and identity documents.
How do I check my payment records?: How do I check my payment records?
Sign in with Google and go to Settings >: Sign in with Google and go to Settings > Transaction Records. All Death Charity payments you have made will be listed there.
How do I check prayer times?: How do I check prayer times?
Go to 'Prayer Times' from the main menu. The app will use your current location to display accurate prayer times. Make sure location permission is enabled.
Can I read Quran surahs in this app?: Can I read Quran surahs in this app?
Yes. Go to 'Surah' from the main menu to: Yes. Go to 'Surah' from the main menu to access a collection of Quran surahs with Arabic text, transliteration, and translation.
What is the Digital Tasbih feature?: What is the Digital Tasbih feature?
The Digital Tasbih allows you to count d: The Digital Tasbih allows you to count dhikr digitally. Tap the button to count and it will keep track of your count.
Asmaul Husna is the list of 99 names of: Asmaul Husna is the list of 99 names of Allah, accessible from the main menu, complete with the meaning of each name.
How do I use the Islamic Calendar?: How do I use the Islamic Calendar?
Go to 'Islamic Calendar' to view Hijri d: Go to 'Islamic Calendar' to view Hijri dates and important Islamic events throughout the year.
Daily Dua contains a collection of suppl: Daily Dua contains a collection of supplications for various daily situations such as eating, sleeping, leaving the house, and more.
Rukun Islam provides an educational guid: Rukun Islam provides an educational guide to the Five Pillars of Islam with explanations for each pillar.
What is the Funeral Prayer (Solat Jenaza: What is the Funeral Prayer (Solat Jenazah) feature?
This feature provides a step-by-step gui: This feature provides a step-by-step guide on performing the funeral prayer, including the intention (niat), recitations, and correct procedure.
Jenazah Emergency allows you to contact: Jenazah Emergency allows you to contact or find nearby funeral management services in an emergency situation.
How do I submit a Jenazah Emergency requ: How do I submit a Jenazah Emergency request?
From Jenazah Emergency, select 'Request: From Jenazah Emergency, select 'Request Service' to submit an emergency request with the deceased's details so a nearby funeral management team can respond quickly.
How do I save a favorite grave, mosque,: How do I save a favorite grave, mosque, or tahfiz centre?
Tap the favorite icon on a grave, mosque: Tap the favorite icon on a grave, mosque, or tahfiz centre listing to save it. You can view all your saved items anytime under 'Favorites' from the main menu.
Kariah Registration lets you register as: Kariah Registration lets you register as a member of your local mosque Kariah, or check your existing membership status by selecting your state and mosque and entering your IC number.
How do I submit a suggestion or report a: How do I submit a suggestion or report an issue?
Go to 'Suggestion' from the main menu or: Go to 'Suggestion' from the main menu or Settings. Fill in your name, phone number, email, the type of record, state, and the relevant grave or deceased record, then submit. Signing in with Google is required.
Why do I need to complete a captcha to s: Why do I need to complete a captcha to submit a suggestion?
The captcha helps prevent spam and abuse: The captcha helps prevent spam and abuse of the suggestion form, ensuring genuine feedback reaches the relevant organisation.
How do I view all my transactions?: How do I view all my transactions?
Sign in with Google and go to Settings >: Sign in with Google and go to Settings > Transaction Records. All transactions including donations, tahlil, quotations, and Death Charity payments will be listed. Tap any record to view full details.
Why are my transaction records not showi: Why are my transaction records not showing?
Make sure you are signed in with the sam: Make sure you are signed in with the same Google account used when making the transaction. If the issue persists, the transaction may have been made without Google sign-in.
How do I change the app language?: How do I change the app language?
Go to Settings and find the Language sec: Go to Settings and find the Language section. You can switch between Malay and English.
How do I enable GPS / location?: How do I enable GPS / location?
Go to Settings in the app and tap 'Enabl: Go to Settings in the app and tap 'Enable GPS'. You can also enable location permission through your device's settings.
